blurb: A record must be constructed with every field that has no default. There is no partial construction: a value of a record type is only valid once all its fields are present, so a downstream reader never has to wonder whether a field was set. Omitting a required field is therefore an error, not a fill-in-later. A field may be left out only when its declaration gives it a default, `field: T = expr`.
summary: A record construction omits a required field.
